body: Are you looking for an efficient confirmation statement service? If your answer is yes, then you have landed at the right place. But before you avail this service, it is important to know certain important facts about it.

The confirmation statement is house filling requirements of all limited companies as well as LLPs. With the introduction of the confirmation statement, the Annual Return has been replaced. The replacement tool place on 30th June 2016. This system has been introduced in order to verify all companies’ information, accuracy, and whether the information provided is up to date or not.
**What is included in a company’s confirmation statement?**

The confirmation statement of a company includes many important details about the company such as the company’s registered address, secretaries, trade, directors, shareholders, shares, and persons who possess significant control. At Brixen Consultants, we will take all the important details of your company to submit the statement to the Companies House and pay the £34 filing fees to complete the process so that you can seamlessly operate the functions of your business with any problem.
**What is the definition of PSC register?**

In the process of PSC registration, a company needs to disclose the names of such persons who significantly control the company either directly or indirectly. For example, a person who owns more than 25% share of the company or voting rights. This is quite straightforward in a small organization but it may turn more complex when shareholders of a company are connected as family members.
**Difference between confirmation statement and Annual return**

The confirmation statement was first introduced on June 30th, 2016 and it replaced the annual return. This statement provides accurate and up-to-date information about the company. The best basic difference between a confirmation statement and an annual plan is the former follows a more straightforward format than the latter. In annual return, it is mandatory to provide all details of the company even if you don’t make any changes in the previous year. But in the confirmation statement, you don’t need to repeat that thing.
